suspects.name: Amelia Vance
suspects.personality: Passionate, impulsive, prone to dramatic outbursts.
suspects.physicalDescription: She has striking features, with long, dark hair often pulled back severely. Her eyes are a deep, intense blue, and she has a slender build. She often wears dark, artistic clothing. A small, silver locket is always around her neck.
suspects.trueAlibi: She was in Victor Sterling's study, arguing with him about money.
suspects.claimedAlibi: She was in the east wing library reading until she heard the commotion.
suspects.trueMotive: Victor Sterling discovered her crippling gambling debts and was blackmailing her.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: She has massive gambling debts and was being blackmailed by the victim.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes agitated and defensive when questioned about her finances or her relationship with the victim.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Marcus Thorne often met with Victor privately and suspects he was involved in something shady. She believes Evelyn Reed resents Victor for his business practices.

suspects.name: Marcus Thorne
suspects.personality: Calm, calculating, meticulous, and slightly arrogant.
suspects.physicalDescription: He has neatly combed, greying black hair and a sharp, angular face. He is impeccably dressed in tailored suits and wears a signet ring on his left hand. His eyes are piercing and observant.
suspects.trueAlibi: He left Victor's study at 9:30 PM and met an informant in the garden until 10:30 PM, discussing sensitive client information.
suspects.claimedAlibi: He left Victor's study around 9:30 PM and went directly home.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He was meeting with a confidential informant in the garden, which he cannot disclose due to client privilege.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes evasive when asked about his exact movements after leaving the study.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Amelia Vance had a volatile relationship with Victor and that Jonathan Price strongly disliked him.

suspects.name: Evelyn Reed
suspects.personality: Sophisticated, reserved, intelligent, and keenly observant.
suspects.physicalDescription: She has elegant silver hair styled in an updo and wears refined, tasteful clothing. Her posture is always perfect. She carries a small, jeweled walking stick.
suspects.trueAlibi: She was in her private gallery on the estate, cataloging new acquisitions from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
suspects.claimedAlibi: She was in her private gallery on the estate, cataloging new acquisitions from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Victor Sterling had a strained relationship with Amelia Vance and that Marcus Thorne handled his most sensitive legal matters.

suspects.name: Jonathan Price
suspects.personality: Gruff, opinionated, and easily angered, but fundamentally decent.
suspects.physicalDescription: He has a hearty build, with a ruddy complexion and a full head of grey hair. He wears thick-rimmed glasses and often sports a tweed jacket.
suspects.trueAlibi: He was at home watching television and reading the newspaper from 9:00 PM onwards.
suspects.claimedAlibi: He was at home watching television and reading the newspaper from 9:00 PM onwards.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Victor Sterling was a disliked figure in business circles and that Amelia Vance was often seen visiting him, appearing distressed.
